```{ojs}
import { readNotebookConfig } from "/helpers/notebook.js";

import { atlasHero } from "/helpers/hero.js";

import { atlasTOC } from "/helpers/toc.ojs";

notebookConfig = readNotebookConfig()
```

```{ojs}
{
  const header = document.createElement("div");
  header.append(
    document.createElement("back-to-top"),
    atlasHero({
      title: nbTitle,
      image: notebookConfig.image,
      alt: notebookConfig.imageAlt?.[language.key] ?? notebookConfig.imageAlt?.en ?? "",
    }),
    atlasTOC({
      selector: notebookConfig.toc?.selector ?? "h1",
      skip: ["notebook-title", "appendix", "source-code"],
      heading: Lang.toSentenceCase(_lang(general_translations.toc)),
    }),
  );
  return header;
}
```
